feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. (1) Iteration 1 (5 sensors, plus or minus 3 cm, 4 cm lead, 12 mm footprints, 0.6 kg, 0.11 m track) is the best evidence so far: score 51.27, s-bend progress 0.155, line_loss 1 per run (entityR2B). (2) Iteration 3 moved the lead to 2 cm and dropped s-bend progress to 0.04 with the same line-loss count. So the lead should stay at 4 cm, and the lead is not the limit at 4 cm. (3) Iteration 2 (plus or minus 6 cm, 16 mm footprints, 3 cm lead) removed line losses to 0 but still exited at max_error about 0.06 m, and s-bend progress fell to 0.04. So a wider span or footprint alone does not fix the exit. (4) Oscillation stayed in 0.065-0.155 in all iterations, and rms_error stayed near 0.03 on every track, which points to a steady offset rather than a geometry limit. Next race: if progress is at least 0.15 on the s-bend and line losses fall to 0, keep the 16 mm footprint and move to plus or minus 4 cm span. If progress falls, restore the 12 mm footprint and keep the 4 cm lead. If line losses stay at 1 with progress unchanged, the controller (gains or ki) is the next lever, not geometry.
